name: Mikoto
source:
Mikoto is a cheerful, outgoing foxgirl with a zest for life. Adventurous and inquisitive, Mikoto wants nothing more than to explore the world around her – but how can she, when her [url=/c87170/]tutor[/url] is so very controlling?!

As Mikoto has few friends, she gets overly attached to [url=/c87168/]Juni[/url] from the get-go. She’s pushy and insistent, and perhaps her advances are a tad inappropriate…but she’s pure at heart, and apologizes whenever she goes too far.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157640/Sakura_Fox_Adventure/]Steam[/url]]
